description: A comprehensive shell script responsible for managing firmware download, validation, and device reboot procedures in an embedded system or set-top box environment. It includes functions for firmware retrieval, download management via direct or codebig methods, safety checks, RFC handling, and maintenance window scheduling.

methods.name: getCurrentFw
methods.description: Retrieves the current firmware version by reading version files.

methods.name: checkFirmwareUpgCriteria
methods.description: Determines if a firmware upgrade is needed by comparing current and available versions.

methods.name: IsCodebigBlocked
methods.description: Checks whether Codebig requests are currently being blocked based on recent failures.

methods.name: get_Codebigconfig
methods.description: Configures and determines if Codebig should be used for firmware download.

methods.name: do_Codebig_signing
methods.description: Generates signed request signatures for codebig requests.

methods.name: useDirectRequest
methods.description: Performs firmware download directly via curl.

methods.name: useCodebigRequest
methods.description: Performs firmware download via codebig, handling signing and request setup.

methods.name: getFirmwareUpgDetail
methods.description: Queries the firmware server for available updates and firmware details.

methods.name: fetchFirmwareDetail
methods.description: Fetches stored firmware details from the last JSON response.

methods.name: calcRandTime
methods.description: Calculates a randomized delay time within maintenance windows.

methods.name: checkMaintenanceWindow
methods.description: Checks if current time falls within the firmware upgrade maintenance window.

methods.name: checkrfcstatus
methods.description: Manages RFC file processing and synchronization with the RFC agent.
